findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice mcqs for Unit 10 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 90 questions numbered 1-90; by section: 10.1 5, 10.1.1 6, 10.1.2 11, 10.2 14, 10.3 11, 10.4 10, 10.5 9, 10.6 10, 10.7 14. Keys: {'a': 22, 'b': 23, 'c': 22, 'd': 23}.

Covers every section 10.1-10.7 in book order (distance formula, fundamental law and its deductions, allied angles, sum and difference formulas, double, half and triple angles, product and sum identities). Angles and values are our own (not the unit's examples or exercises). Every key and distractor was checked by computation in Python (sympy, check10_mcq.py). Book corrections followed: cos(pi/2 + theta) = -sin theta, sin(3pi/2 - theta) = -cos theta, tan(270 deg + theta) = -cot theta, cos(a + b) + cos(a - b) = 2 cos a cos b, tan 3alpha (not tan cubed).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
